dualEnrollment.deadlineNote: Delgado posts its dual enrollment application deadline for each session on its dual enrollment page. Check the current deadline table there before the session you want.
dualEnrollment.note: Delgado is one of the colleges taking dual enrollment applications through ApplyDE, the Board of Regents common application. Approval from the student, a parent, and the high school principal or counselor is required.

admission.basis: First-time freshman application deadlines. Admission is rolling, so these are the published closing dates, not the only dates an application can be sent.
admission.transcriptNote: College credit, including dual enrollment, is awarded from the official college transcript, not the high school transcript. The student asks the college that awarded the credit to send the official transcript with final grades to UL Lafayette.

admission.basis: Domestic undergraduate application deadlines published by LSU New Orleans (the University of New Orleans). Each term has a priority deadline for scholarship consideration and a final application deadline.
admission.fee: Domestic undergraduate application fees are currently waived for Spring and Fall 2027.
admission.transcriptNote: Have the official transcript from every college attended sent to the LSU New Orleans Office of Admissions.

stateLinks.applyDENote: ApplyDE is the Board of Regents common application for dual enrollment. The colleges on it today are South Louisiana Community College, SOWELA, SUNO, Delgado, and LSU A&M, with more joining, including Southern for Fall 2027.
stateLinks.laDualEnrollmentNote: LaDualEnrollment.com is the state's dual enrollment hub for students and families.
